subject: IAM evidence & SOC 2 follow-up — Helix Bio
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixbio.com>
Cc: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: IAM evidence & SOC 2 follow-up — Helix Bio

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great to learn more about Helix Bio's roadmap for embedding LLM capabilities into your internal research workflows. Per our call, I wanted to recap the security/compliance items you flagged and propose next steps so we can keep the evaluation moving: 

Summary of asks from Helix: 
- SOC 2 status / auditor contact (Type II report and timeline for next audit)
- Proof of SSO/SAML (IdP metadata, SAML configs) and SCIM provisioning docs
- RBAC / admin controls overview (how super-admins are managed, admin audit logs)
- Vendor security questionnaire (you mentioned you would send Helix's template)

What we can provide immediately 
- Redwood_IAM_Evidence_Guide.pdf (short guide with example artifacts for SSO, SCIM, RBAC) — attached.
- SOC 2: we are SOC 2 Type II certified; I can share the auditor contact and redacted report after an NDA/TPA as needed.
- SSO/SAML and SCIM: I can provide our SAML metadata, recommended IdP settings, and SCIM endpoints + sample provisioning logs.

Proposed next steps 
1) Can you send over the vendor questionnaire as an attachment so we can map evidence to each line item? (Olivia or you)
2) I'll loop in Elliot (solutions engineer) for a technical deep-dive to walk through SAML/SCIM demo and RBAC examples. He is available next week — what windows work for your team?
3) If helpful, we can start populating answers in your questionnaire and share a secure Drive link for artifacts.

Please confirm who on your side will own the questionnaire items (Olivia?) and I’ll get the SAML metadata and evidence guide over right away.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0134

Attachments: Redwood_IAM_Evidence_Guide.pdf

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixbio.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helixbio.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IAM evidence & SOC 2 follow-up — Helix Bio

Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the guide — helpful. Olivia is the security lead here and will own the questionnaire. I attached our vendor security questionnaire (Excel) — it’s fairly standard but has a few custom items about provisioning and audit logs.

A couple quick notes from our side: 
- SOC 2: we need the redacted Type II report and auditor contact; we can sign an NDA if required.
- For SAML/SCIM: we use Okta as IdP and SCIM for provisioning; please include sample SCIM provisioning logs and the endpoint URL we should call for test provisioning.
- RBAC: we need to understand how role hierarchy maps to organization-level admin roles and how we can restrict access to production models.

We’re aiming to have answers back to our security team by the end of next week (EOW 6/25). Can Elliot do a 30–45 min technical session next Tue 6/22 or Wed 6/23 in the morning PT?

Thanks —
Daniel
Director of IT, Helix Bio
daniel.park@helixbio.com | +1 (650) 555-0199

Attachment: Helix_Vendor_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@helixbio.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@helixbio.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 08:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IAM evidence & SOC 2 follow-up — Helix Bio

Daniel / Olivia —

Perfect, thanks for sending the questionnaire. I kicked off an internal mapping and attached a Drive link where we’ll drop artifacts as we prepare them: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Helix_IAM_Evidence_Checklist

Elliot — can you confirm availability for a technical deep-dive next Tue 6/22 9:30–10:15 AM PT or Wed 6/23 10:00–10:45 AM PT? We need to cover: SAML IdP metadata exchange, SCIM test provisioning (create/update/deactivate), and RBAC admin/audit log examples.

Aditya — looping you in to confirm SOC 2 redacted report delivery and the auditor contact details. We may need a standard NDA before sending the full report; can you advise?

Olivia — if you prefer, I can start populating the questionnaire (tab-by-tab) and flag items that need evidence uploads.

Next milestone: shared answers + artifacts in Drive by EOW 6/25.

Best,
Marissa
